title: Post-training
tagline: Instruction tuning, reward models, RLHF, preference optimisation and parameter-efficient fine-tuning
summary: A pretrained model predicts text; an assistant follows instructions. This course covers supervised instruction tuning, reward modelling and reinforcement learning from human feedback, direct preference optimisation, AI feedback and constitutional methods, and the parameter-efficient methods that make fine-tuning cheap.

overview: Post-training aligns pretrained LLMs with human preferences. This course covers instruction tuning, RLHF, DPO, and reward modeling.
The key insight is that alignment is a fine-tuning problem: models learn preferences from preference data and reward signals.
outcomes: Explain instruction tuning and supervised fine-tuning.
Describe RLHF: reward models, PPO, and KL constraints.
Analyze DPO and preference optimization without RL.
Evaluate alignment quality and helpfulness-harmlessness trade-offs.

history.title: InstructGPT
history.detail: Ouyang et al. introduced RLHF with InstructGPT, aligning LLMs with human preferences.

history.title: DPO
history.detail: Rafailov et al. introduced Direct Preference Optimization as a simpler alignment method.

history.title: KTO
history.detail: Ethayarajh et al. introduced KTO for binary preference optimization.
